town_letter.name: Misdirected Letter
town_letter.description: Second post, Castle. Miss Dray has written the right address across the front in pencil. The postmark is next Sunday's.

town_washing.name: Washing
town_washing.description: Off Mrs Marsh's line at No. 5, High Street. It's bone dry, and it went out wet.

town_cap.name: Robert's Cap
town_cap.description: R. HALE is written inside the band. A boy's cloth cap, off the peg inside the Forge door. It's still damp.

town_loaf.name: A Loaf
town_loaf.description: For No. 7, Pound Lane. Mrs Oddie's, wrapped in paper. It is not for eating.
